classes_description.description: Includes mainly chemical products for use in industry, science and agriculture, including those which go to the making of products belonging to other classes.
Includes mainly paints, colorants and preparations used for protection against corrosion.
Includes mainly non-medicated toiletry preparations, as well as cleaning preparations for use in the home and other environments.
Includes mainly industrial oils and greases, fuels and illuminants.
Includes mainly pharmaceuticals and other preparations for medical or veterinary purposes.
Includes mainly unwrought and partly wrought common metals, including ores, as well as certain goods made of common metals.
Includes mainly machines and machine tools, motors and engines.
Includes mainly hand tools and implements, hand-operated; cutlery; side arms, except firearms; razors.
Includes mainly apparatus and instruments for scientific or research purposes, audiovisual and information technology equipment, computer software as well as safety and life-saving equipment.
Includes mainly surgical, medical, dental and veterinary apparatus, instruments.
Includes mainly environmental control apparatus and installations, in particular, for the purposes of lighting, cooking, cooling and sanitizing.
Includes mainly vehicles and apparatus.
Includes mainly firearms and pyrotechnic products.
Includes mainly precious metals and certain goods made of precious metals or coated therewith, as well as jewellery, clocks and watches, and component parts therefor.
Includes mainly musical instruments, their parts and their accessories.
Includes mainly paper, cardboard and certain goods made of those materials, as well as office requisites.
Includes mainly electrical, thermal and acoustic insulating materials and plastics for use in manufacture as well as certain goods made of rubber, gutta-percha, gum etc.
Includes mainly leather, imitations of leather and certain goods made of those materials including bags.
Includes mainly non-metallic materials for building and construction.
Includes mainly furniture and parts therefor, as well as certain goods made of wood or of plastic.

Includes mainly small, hand-operated utensils and apparatus for household and kitchen use, as well as cosmetic and toilet utensils, glassware and certain goods made of porcelain, ceramic, earthenware, terra-cotta or glass.
Includes mainly canvas and other materials for making sails, rope, padding, cushioning and stuffing materials and raw fibrous textile materials.
Includes mainly natural or synthetic yarns and threads for textile use.
Includes mainly fabrics and fabric covers for household use.
Includes mainly clothing, footwear and headwear for human beings.
Includes mainly dressmakers' articles, natural or synthetic hair for wear, and hair accessories.
Includes mainly products intended to be added as coverings to previously constructed floors and walls.
Includes mainly toys, apparatus for playing games, sports equipment, amusement and novelty items.
Includes mainly foodstuffs of animal origin, as well as vegetables and other horticultural comestible products which are prepared or preserved for consumption.
Includes mainly foodstuffs of plant origin, except fruits and vegetables, prepared or preserved for consumption, as well as auxiliaries intended for the improvement of the flavour of food.
Includes mainly land and sea products not having been subjected to any form of preparation for consumption, live animals and plants, as well as foodstuffs for animals.
Includes mainly non-alcoholic beverages, as well as beer.
Includes mainly alcoholic beverages, essences and extracts.
Includes mainly tobacco and articles used for smoking, as well as certain accessories and containers related to their use.
Includes mainly services involving business management, as well as advertising, marketing and promotional services, retail and wholesale services.
Includes mainly services relating to banking and other financial transactions, financial valuation services, as well as insurance and real estate activities.
Includes mainly services in the field of construction.
Includes mainly telecommunication services and transmission of data.
Includes mainly services for the transport of people, animals or goods as well as the storing of goods.
Includes mainly services rendered by the mechanical or chemical processing, transformation or production of objects or inorganic or organic substances, including custom manufacturing services.

Includes mainly services consisting of all forms of education or training, services having the basic aim of the entertainment, amusement or recreation of people, as well as the presentation of works of visual art or literature to the public for cultural or educational purposes.

Includes mainly services provided by persons in relation to the theoretical and practical aspects of complex fields of activities, for example, scientific laboratory services, engineering, computer programming, architectural services or interior design.
Includes mainly services provided in relation to the preparation of food and drink for consumption, as well as services for providing temporary accommodation.

Includes mainly medical care, including alternative medicine, hygienic and beauty care given by persons or establishments to human beings and animals, as well as services relating to the fields of agriculture, aquaculture, horticulture and forestry.
Includes mainly legal and security services, as well as certain personal and social services rendered by others to meet the needs of individuals.

searchField.default_title: What will you use your trademark for?
searchField.default_description:
Registering your trademark offers protection for your branding's goods and/or services. Please select the goods/services relevant to your branding.

Please enter simple keywords (one or two at a time is easiest) to find and specify your desired goods or services. For example, simple keywords include: retail, online, software, digital, advisory, consultancy, business, financial, sales, management, machine, book, car, furniture.

You may choose as many goods/services as you like. You may select many items in each class if you wish. Remember to click the “see more” button to drop down additional goods/services (where available).

For further guidance please see this link on how to choose your goods/services, you can refer to our FAQs.
